newsitem.title: USA: Mass.officials recount votes for Studd's successor.
newsitem.headline: Mass.officials recount votes for Studd's successor.

text.p: The Democratic candidate to fill the seat being vacated by 12-term congressman Gerry Studds is still to be determined, Massachusetts election officials said Tuesday.

Norfolk County District Attorney William Delahunt, who went into the race a heavy favorite according to published polls, has filed recount petitions in seven municipalities after the results from last Tuesday's primary showed him losing to former state and federal human services official Philip Johnston by 266 votes.

Massachusetts Secretary of State William Galvin, whose office will supervise the recount, said the tally could begin Tuesday or as late as Saturday depending on how soon local election officials could validate Delahunt's petitions.
Election officials, who noted that the turnout during last week's heavy rains and high winds was extremely light, noted a number of large number of blank ballots were received in several towns.
Studds, a Democrat from Cape Cod, announced last October he would not seek re-election after 24 years in the House.
